_comment: Hand-verified tracked-company -> SEC ticker map, for cases where the legal
name on EDGAR differs from the name we track (Uber -> 'Uber Technologies',
Meta -> 'Meta Platforms'). Every entry here was checked by eye against the
This file exists because automatic prefix matching cannot tell a correct
qualifier from a different company: 'Uber' -> 'Uber Technologies' is right,
'Mercury' -> 'Mercury Systems' is a defense contractor. Same shape, opposite
answer. Never replace this with a heuristic.
Entries are verified again at run time against data.sec.gov (entity name +
10-K presence); anything that fails there drops out rather than being trusted.
_blocklist_comment: Names that must NEVER be auto-matched. Each one previously resolved to an
unrelated public company. 'Oura' is the worst: the ticker file's OURA entry
carries a CIK that data.sec.gov resolves to BlackRock, Inc.
